ColorMap.description: Base color map containing silver armor plate, dark navy secondary plates, crimson cape weave, and dark navy hair roots.

NormalMap.description: DirectX tangent space normal map for beveled plate edges, hammered metal texture, and the Three-Bolt Storm Crown chest relief.

RoughnessMap.description: Grayscale: 0.20-0.30 for polished silver armor highlights; 0.55 for navy plates; 0.90 for matte fabric cape.

MetalnessMap.description: Grayscale binary mask: 1.0 (pure white) for silver and navy armor; 0.0 (pure black) for cape fabric, skin, and neon crystal.

EmissiveMap.description: Cyan glow channel for the Three-Bolt Storm Crown, swept hair tips, and warhammer battery core.
